    //==
    // The named point <-> vector converters. These are the long-standing spelling
    // (curves-shapes.library.plato and the transform libraries call PositionVector);
    // they now delegate to the IOriginBased conversions rather than restating the
    // field copy, so there is one place where a point becomes a vector.
    // ToPoint reads in the opposite direction from FromOffset — it dispatches on
    // the VECTOR, which is what callers holding a vector want.

    // The point's displacement from the origin.
    PositionVector(p: Point2D): Vector2D
        => p.Offset;
